notes: v8.9.4: GUI-freeze fix + console latency probe. (1) Watchdog heartbeat decoupled from UI work: WM_TIMER now only ticks the heartbeat and posts the label refresh as its own message (WM_APP_META) instead of running refreshMeta() inside the timer handler — a stalled label update/paint used to stall the heartbeat itself, so the watchdog mistook a busy UI for a dead one and restarted mid-call (agent-14.log, Oct 30). The message pump also ticks the heartbeat after each dispatched message. (2) Status changes now repaint only the header band instead of the whole window. (3) New ping->pong reply so the console can show live session latency. Camera (MF + DirectShow fallback) and mic paths unchanged from v8.9.3.
